affix.nirncraft.maker.abah_corsair.desc: Brass-fitted boarding gear waterproofed with pitch in the hidden coves of Hew's Bane.
affix.nirncraft.maker.akaviri_tempered.d: Differential clay-tempered edge bearing the wave-line of the old Dragonguard armouries.
Filigree malachite and moonstone drawn on high-elven mandrels descended from Direnni workshops.
affix.nirncraft.maker.argonian_hist_cure: Steeped in marsh-sap lacquer that shrugs off brackish fen water and salt fog alike.
affix.nirncraft.maker.ayleid_etched.desc: Chased with starlight latticework recovered from white-stone vaults of the Heartland.
affix.nirncraft.maker.bosmer_bone.desc: Sinew-bound horn and cured bone laminated without touching living timber.
affix.nirncraft.maker.breton_guild_steel: Stamped with a chartered Iliac guildhall touchmark and balanced for chivalric tournament lists.
affix.nirncraft.maker.dunmer_bonemold.de: Resin-cured ash-bone and chitin plates laminated against cinders by Velothi outlanders.
affix.nirncraft.maker.dwemer_wrought.des: Cast in tonal brass-alloy that resists rust even after centuries beneath steam conduits.
affix.nirncraft.maker.imperial_legion_is: Quartermaster-inspected steel stamped with the cohort numeral of an Imperial border garrison.
affix.nirncraft.maker.khajiit_moon_forge: Curved caravan steel polished with fine dune-silica for silent draw along desert roads.
affix.nirncraft.maker.markarth_silver.de: Karth-gorge iron chased with Cidhna silver wire by crag-smiths of the western Reach.
affix.nirncraft.maker.orsinium_forged.de: Beaten over Wrothgarian anthracite by stronghold smith-wives who alloy iron with green orichalcum.
affix.nirncraft.maker.redguard_folded.de: Watered steel folded twelve times in Dragontail charcoal according to Ra Gada sword-canon.
affix.nirncraft.maker.skyforge.desc: Quenched beside the eagle-stone above Jorrvaskr where ancient hearth-coal never cools.
affix.nirncraft.maker.windhelm_hearth.de: Thick winter-forged plate hammered beside the White River docks to endure Sea of Ghosts gales.
affix.nirncraft.storied.alikr_volenfell_: Scoured bright by salt-devil winds where Rourken's bronze hammer first struck the desert basin.
affix.nirncraft.storied.anticlere_charte: Pledged as surety between two feuding hill-barons before the border keep consolidated their valleys.
affix.nirncraft.storied.bangkorai_ephesu: Held the canyon parapet when garrison shield-lines turned back three northern invading armies.
affix.nirncraft.storied.bjoulsae_evermor: Hung from a river-warden's saddle during the border cavalry campaigns along the Druadach foothills.
affix.nirncraft.storied.craglorn_star_ca: Forged from meteoric iron gathered beneath the shattered observatory domes of old Craglorn.
affix.nirncraft.storied.daggerfall_cryng: Trampled into heather mud when King Lysandus fell before the arrow-storm on the southern moors.
affix.nirncraft.storied.daggerfall_numid: Bears two conflicting royal timestamps from the day the Brass God folded six kingdoms into four.
affix.nirncraft.storied.dragontail_scour: Quenched in sulphurous mountain runoff where Dragontail pass-sentries watch the northern ridge.
affix.nirncraft.storied.dwynnen_bhoriane: Carried across the stony river causeway when Duke Eadwyre's lancers broke the western coastal raiders.
affix.nirncraft.storied.eastmarch_ysgram: Notched with tally-marks along its guard by a shield-thane who sailed south from Atmora's freezing shoals.
affix.nirncraft.storied.falkreath_pine_e: Lifted from a mossy jarl-cairn under dripping Falkreath pines where funeral bells toll every autumn.
affix.nirncraft.storied.glenumbra_camlor: Tempered during the autumn muster when Direnni spell-captains broke the Alessian host on the moors.
affix.nirncraft.storied.haafingar_wolf_w: Sealed inside a lead reliquary beneath the Blue Palace after Potema's necromancers were driven from the arch.
affix.nirncraft.storied.hews_bane_hubala: Smuggled out of Taneth's harbour vaults on the night the southern sea-lanes changed hands.
affix.nirncraft.storied.hjaalmarch_bromj: Unearthed beneath peat and bog-myrtle outside the shattered stone ring of Labyrinthian.
affix.nirncraft.storied.pale_korvanjund_: Kept greased in horker tallow by sentries who guarded the Jagged Crown's subterranean stair.
affix.nirncraft.storied.reach_old_hrolda: Hammered where storm-magic cracked the limestone battlements above the Karth gorge.
affix.nirncraft.storied.rift_forelhost_r: Recovered from the poisoned cistern terraces high above the golden birch valleys of the Rift.
affix.nirncraft.storied.rivenspire_doomc: Inscribed with silver containment runes after the Ebon Crypt fissure poisoned the western chalk ridges.
affix.nirncraft.storied.sentinel_first_l: Etched with the prow-sigil of the Ra Gada captains who anchored beneath Sentinel's red headland.
affix.nirncraft.storied.stormhaven_abbey: Blessed with rosemary oil by chantry wardens who patrol the old pilgrim road above Wayrest Sound.
affix.nirncraft.storied.stros_hunding_pr: Salvaged from the charred flagship timbers after Prince A'tor's fleet burned in the southern bay.
affix.nirncraft.storied.wayrest_direnni_: Stamped with a swan-and-tower countermark from the merchant princes who raised the harbour sea-chain.
affix.nirncraft.storied.whiterun_jorrvas: Sworn over upturned mead-plank timber when the Five Hundred first climbed onto the windy tundra bluff.
affix.nirncraft.storied.whiterun_watchto: Scorched along the fuller during the night the western watchtower stones cracked under dragonfire.
affix.nirncraft.storied.winterhold_saart: Pulled from the collapsed cliff-rubble after the Sea of Ghosts swallowed three-quarters of the old capital.
affix.nirncraft.storied.wrothgar_paragon: Salvaged from the vitrified gate-stones of old Orsinium after the thirty-year siege finally ended.
